diagnosticsStructured.description: Non-fatal findings as structured entries (srs-rust#1491); the same findings the envelope's `diagnostics` list carries as text.

schema.description: A draft-07 JSON Schema describing a record's `fieldValues` for this Type. Dynamic shape; emitted opaquely (see ADR-011 for the dynamic-value convention).

DiagnosticPayload.description: One structured finding, beside the text `diagnostics` list on the render, find, container view, blueprint, navigation and type_schema surfaces (srs-rust#1491, ADR-057). Mirrors `diagnostic::Diagnostic`. `message` is the text-list entry verbatim.

code.description: The stable rule identifier, in today's spelling.
